# gyro_container_service (Resource)

A service in a Gyro Containers (ECS) environment (Istanbul, tr-ist-1): a Docker image running on the node pool dedicated to you. Every change except `replicas` creates a new revision that rolls out without downtime. Secret values are stored encrypted and never read back (Terraform keeps what you configured). Domains activate once their DNS points to the service `host` (CNAME).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A web service in your Gyro Containers (ECS) environment (Istanbul).
# service_id is the id of the container environment you ordered (see gyro_services).
variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "gyro_container_service" "web" {
  service_id  = 123
  name        = "web"
  image       = "ghcr.io/acme/web:1.4"
  port        = 8080
  cpu_m       = 500
  memory_mi   = 512
  public      = true
  health_path = "/healthz"

  env     = { MODE = "prod" }
  secrets = { DB_PASSWORD = var.db_password } # write only, never read back

  # Replicas follow the load: 2..6, target 70 % CPU of cpu_m (replicas is ignored while autoscaling is set).
  autoscaling = {
    min         = 2
    max         = 6
    cpu_percent = 70
  }
  # Alert when fewer than 2 replicas are ready (channels: gyro_container_notifications).
  notification = {
    min_ready = 2
  }

  # Point a CNAME from your domain to gyro_container_service.web.host first.
  domains = ["app.example.com"]
}

output "web_url" {
  value = gyro_container_service.web.url
}

# Secrets kept out of the Terraform state (Terraform 1.11+ write-only argument): bump secrets_wo_version to push new values.
resource "gyro_container_service" "worker" {
  service_id         = gyro_container_environment.app.id
  name               = "worker"
  image              = "ghcr.io/gyro-proje/worker:1.0"
  secrets_wo         = { DB_PASSWORD = var.db_password, RABBITMQ_URL = var.rabbitmq_url }
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image reference, e.g. ghcr.io/acme/web:1.4.
- `name` (String) Service name: lowercase letters, digits and '-', max 40.
- `service_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `args` (List of String) Arguments for the command.
- `autoscaling` (Attributes) Autoscaling: when set, the replica count follows the average CPU (and optionally memory) use of the reserved size between min and max (up fast, down one per minute after 3 calm minutes); `replicas` is then ignored. Max cannot exceed the plan replica limit. Not a revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling))
- `command` (List of String) Override the image entrypoint.
- `cpu_m` (Number) CPU per instance in millicores.
- `domains` (Set of String) Your domains (CNAME to `host`); requires public = true.
- `env` (Map of String) Plain environment variables. Names: letters, digits and `_`, not starting with a digit, max 128; `GYRO_` / `KUBERNETES_` prefixes are reserved. Invalid names (also invisible copy-paste characters such as U+200B) are rejected at plan time. A value that starts with an invisible character (U+200B, U+FEFF, U+200C, U+200D, U+2060) is rejected at plan time too (since 0.24.4); the platform would strip it.
- `health_path` (String) HTTP health check path (empty = TCP check).
- `memory_mi` (Number) Memory per instance in MiB.
- `notification` (Attributes) Per-service alert threshold; channels are set with gyro_container_notifications. Left out = off (min_ready 0). An imported service always reads it back, also when it is off ({ min_ready = 0 }). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification))
- `port` (Number) Container port (0 = no network port). Use >= 1024 (non-root).
- `public` (Boolean) Public HTTPS address <name>-<code>.gyroapp.net.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of instances (0 = stopped).
- `run_as_user` (Number) User id in the container (0 = platform default 10001).
- `secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret environment variables (values are kept in the Terraform state; a key removed outside Terraform shows as a diff). Same name rules as `env`. To keep values out of the state use `secrets_wo`.
- `secrets_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret environment variables that are never stored in the Terraform state or plan (write-only argument, Terraform 1.11+). Sent when the service is created and whenever secrets_wo_version changes - bump the version to push new values. Keys dropped from the map (compared with secrets_wo_keys) are deleted. After import (or when secrets_wo_version is first added) the next apply sends secrets_wo once. Cannot be combined with secrets.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Change this number (e.g. 1 -> 2) to send secrets_wo again; while it stays the same, secrets_wo is not sent.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Public host name; CNAME target for your domains.
- `id` (String) <service_id>/<name>
- `internal_address` (String) In-cluster address <name>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local:80 (services with a port; other services of the same environment can also use <name>:80). Empty when port = 0.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace of the environment.
- `revision` (Number) Current revision number.
- `secrets_wo_keys` (List of String) Names (not values) of the secrets last sent with secrets_wo, sorted.
- `state` (String) running, deploying, failing, pending, stopped or suspended (at the last read).
- `url` (String) Public URL (public services).

<a id="nestedatt--autoscaling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autoscaling`

Required:

- `max` (Number) Maximum replicas (<= plan limit).
- `min` (Number) Minimum replicas (>= 1).

Optional:

- `cpu_percent` (Number) Target average CPU use in % of cpu_m (10-95).
- `memory_percent` (Number) Target average memory use in % of memory_mi (0 = off, else 10-95).


<a id="nestedatt--notification"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification`

Required:

- `min_ready` (Number) Alert when fewer replicas are ready (0 = off).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_container_service.web 123/web
```
